title: ECW’s last champions and unfinished ending
summary: The original ECW ends with active rivalries rather than a planned series finale. Its last pay-per-view crowns new champions, and a small live event supplies the promotion’s final matches.

chapters.title: The final original ECW pay-per-view
chapters.result: Sandman wins the world title and immediately loses it to Rhino; RVD later defeats Lynn.
chapters.context: The show leaves several stories open, without announcing a permanent end to the promotion.

chapters.title: The final live event
chapters.result: Rhino retains against Spike; Sandman wins the final rematch against Credible.
chapters.context: This is the last original ECW event, distinct from its later bankruptcy and WWE-produced reunions.
